summary: Implementation plan for enhancing the Classic Backup (Favourites JSON) portable export and import system in Pulse Player. Preserves pulseplayer.favorites v1 format with fuzzy matching, includes both auto-created Music/Pulse Player (MediaStore/Environment) and custom SAF folder destinations, exports copied favorites alongside library favorites with byte-for-byte copy and reuse deduplication, provides real-time progress callbacks and error telemetry, and verifies that importing from the folder on a new device seamlessly restores all favorites.
